title: Lythara Encounter Builder
description: Reads an encounter map, then places monsters, treasure and GM notes from a brief, and carries out monster turns from a plan one action at a time, which a Claude chat or the API can hand in through one brain interface. Each monster acts through its mind: a behaviour profile the GM can read and edit, kept in a reusable library.

recommends.reason: Reads its encounter maps. Without it the builder works from walls and regions alone.
